rules.title: Low text content on indexable page
rules.description: The page has very little visible text. Google has no preferred word count; this only flags pages to review whether they satisfy their purpose (e.g. empty category pages, placeholder pages).
rules.fix: Add content that serves the page's purpose, consolidate, or noindex placeholder pages.

sources.title: Google: Creating helpful, reliable, people-first content

rules.exceptions: Contact, login, app and media pages are naturally short.

rules.title: Near-duplicate pages
rules.description: Pages share most of their text (shingle similarity ≥ 0.9). Near-duplicates compete with each other and dilute signals.
rules.fix: Merge, differentiate, or canonicalise near-duplicate pages.

sources.title: Google: How to specify a canonical URL
Google: Creating helpful, reliable, people-first content

rules.title: Pages targeting the same topic
rules.description: Several indexable pages share the same primary terms in title and H1. They may compete for the same queries. Confirm with Search Console query data before acting.
rules.fix: Differentiate intent per page or consolidate into one stronger page.
rules.verify: Check Search Console queries per page.

sources.title: Google: Creating helpful, reliable, people-first content

rules.title: URLs use underscores
rules.description: Google recommends hyphens instead of underscores to separate words in URLs.
rules.fix: Use hyphens for new URLs. Do not rename existing URLs without 301 redirects.
rules.exceptions: Changing established URLs has costs; only apply to new content or with redirects.

rules.title: Session or tracking parameters in internal links
rules.description: Internal links contain session IDs or tracking parameters, creating many URLs for the same content and wasting crawl budget.
rules.fix: Remove tracking/session parameters from internal links; use cookies or analytics config instead.
rules.verify: Re-crawl and check internal link URLs.

sources.title: Google: Large site owner's guide to managing crawl budget
